requirements.description: Valid-qualified and flush-safe activation of Zcmp macro_decoder and Zcmt zcmt_decoder, suppressing fetch_entry_ready_o during flush_i and killing in-flight TABLE_JUMP requests.
Un-gated combinational micro-op emission and accurate per-micro-op acceptance handshaking across empty/full ID-Issue pipeline register states and downstream backpressure.
Zero inferred latches, zero combinational SCCs, cell area <= 2560.0 um^2, and setup/hold slack >= 0.0 ns at 1.95 ns clock period in Nangate45.
